title: Follow-up acted on: closing or re-routing the 50 tasks and asks that fell through

chat.text: The computed follow-up list found 36 quiet tasks, 3 with no outcome, 2 with unmerged commits and 9 asks with no live owner. A Sonnet task mastermind has Haiku minions read each one's log, writes a landing line (landed, superseded, or open with what is left), merges the records-only branches, reviews the one code branch, and re-routes the asks. Property.of stays yours.
